columns.header: Reason; tried by then / shown beside / compared later / not tried
When: before or after its output; seen then

value.text: NRC VAD v2.1, a sentence the mean of its terms

value.format: common to the series, assumed relief depth D = {D_mm} mm

reason.why: keeps the depth differences between sentences

value.literal: four shown together, the series using the grey of the height; grey; lit at 45 degrees from upper left, lower right; stretched per tile

reason.why: also a quantity the maker sets (one viewpoint)

rows_work1.when: before; seen: earlier images and values of work 1

value.text: MEmoLon (Japanese) through map B, fitted to English ratings

reason.why: brings the Japanese values onto the English scale
later_compared: two other maps, on check sentences

judged.text: two makers (one blind), with the sheet and example

value.text: V and A as percentiles in the 23 works, each author weighted equally

reason.why: spreads values map B compresses; stretches small predicted differences, most in A

rows_work2.when: after; seen: sketches with these percentiles, whole-lexicon percentiles

row_rule: the main text shows only the rows that bear on its claims (decision of the researcher, 2026-10-29, on the word count): the two sides of each comparison whose effect the paper reports (work 1: the lexicon, whose share the paper sets next to random sentences of the same lengths, the height scale, whose alternative is the per-tile min-max, and the drawing; work 2: map B and the percentiles); the subject of work 2, a decision about what the paper claims and not a quantity of the works, and every other decision of works 1 and 2 are in the full table of supplement S1, with the longer wording (decision 1 of the researcher after round 8)
acted_on_labels: in the repository the column holds the image files; the numbers of the figures of the paper are put in when the manuscript is made, outside the repository

layout.empty_template: the same table with the six headers and three empty rows is drawn below it
layout.row_order: a band 'Work 1' and its rows, then a band 'Work 2' and its rows, each in the order of the conditions
layout.reason_format: '{why}. Tried: {a}; {b}.' or '{why}. Tried: none.', followed by ' Shown beside: {c}.' when shown_beside is not empty, by ' Later compared with: {d}.' when later_compared is not empty and by ' Not tried: {e}.' when not_tried is not empty (items joined by '; '), with the first letter of why in upper case; Tried names the alternatives tried by the time of the decision, Shown beside those drawn next to the chosen one, Later compared with those computed after the decision; the header names the four kinds, and 'tried by then' is what Tried names
layout.print: drawn in one grey channel (mode L) on white, with no colour; every font size is at least 7 pt at the printed width
layout.note: under the filled table, one line for each text of note

outputs: results/decision_note_v10/decision_note.png, decision_note.md (the same table as text) and decision_note.json (the values read, the SHA-256 of the conditions, the counts of words); results/decision_note (version 2), results/decision_note_v4, results/decision_note_v5 results/decision_note_v6, results/decision_note_v7, results/decision_note_v8 and results/decision_note_v9 are kept
words: the words drawn are counted as whitespace-separated tokens of the text of each cell (as built by the script), the headers, the band labels, the note and the titles, for the filled and the empty table; a path of an image is one word and a mark standing alone (*) is also one word; the counts are recorded and enter the word count of the outline (the template of the journal counts tables and charts); the run stops if the two tables together exceed max_words
not_claimed: A way of noting decisions; it does not show that noting them helps a reader (no study with people). Disclosure helps a reader repeat the work but does not by itself settle whether a reading is valid or a choice biased. The column of who judged names the judgement made, not the viewers of the paper; 'none recorded' means no look was judged with a sheet, not that the makers did not look. The four rows are chosen by the rule above, not as the decisions that mattered most. The reasons are the makers' statements as recorded in the decision table; they are not checked against a file and do not show that a choice was right. The judged cells of work 2 speak of the row of the 20 words only (the other rows of the blind judgement are in S1); they were judged on the images of the judgement (80 px tiles under five common seeds), not on figure 6 itself. The share used is a record of the words and sentences of the works, counted after their values and images were seen: the middle half of f and s of the 104 sentences of work 1, set next to random sentences with the same numbers of matched terms, drawn uniformly from its lexicon (the same unit; the share beside is the mean over 1000 replicates), and of the 120 words of the main images of work 2 under map B and under the percentiles, not a property of the map or of the lexicon (the shares on the reference sets, the matched terms of work 1 and the minimum to maximum are in S1); the random sentences draw every term of the lexicon with the same chance, which no text does; using more of a range is not claimed to be better, and the share says nothing of how reliable the values are. 'Shown beside' names an alternative drawn next to the chosen one after the decision; 'Later compared with' names an alternative computed after the decision; neither is a reason of the decision.
checks: every file named exists and is the one at HEAD; every key read exists; every must_contain string occurs in the keys named (else the run stops)
every image of compared is one of acted_on of its row; the judged of each row is 'none recorded', a literal checked where a check is given, or a text with answers; no row carries the dagger
every row has a reason with a non-empty why and lists tried, shown_beside, later_compared and not_tried of non-empty strings (possibly empty)
3 rows of work 1 and 2 of work 2 (asserted as constants), and 6 columns
the saved image, opened again, is mode L at the width of the layout and its dpi, the font drawn (after rounding to pixels) is at least 7 pt, and each line of the note is one line
the words of the two tables together are at most max_words
the share of each quantity named in used_range (and beside) is read and checked by used_range_rule, its rounding is the string shown for that quantity, and the phrase of the share is built from it
the outcome of every judged row with answers is computed by answers_rule from the two lists, is the outcome written, and the phrase of the outcome is built from it

no text of a row (quantity, value, reason, image paths, when, judged) contains a reserved mark, and no literal contains a percentage or, in a row of work 2, names words (reserved_marks, required_checks)
the ids of the rows are, in order, those fixed in the script (w1_lexicon, w1_height_scale, w1_drawing; w2_map_b, w2_percentiles); the version of each row of work 2 is read by its id
every row, as written in these conditions, equals the row fixed in the script for its id, and the headers, titles, note, label line and marks equal those fixed in the script (approved_text_rule)
the files of the two judges are the ones fixed in the script (main: results/blind_judgement/score.json, also: results/blind_judgement/score-researcher-supplement.json) and differ

no cell holds a percentage, a percent sign (also full-width) or the word percent or per cent, except the value of a row with used_range, whose percentages are exactly those built from the record, in the order f, s and, beside, f, s; this holds for every kind of value, a format of keys included

the version of the answers of each row of work 2 is the version fixed in the script for its id (map B: G0, the percentiles: P), and the record, set and set beside of each share are those of used_range_rule

every share shown is computed again from the values word by word or sentence by sentence (used_range_rule); the random sentences of work 1 are drawn again from the seed and compared replicate by replicate, and the rows of the words of the percentiles are matched one to one with words.json

dagger.meaning: claim weakened in the paper after the values were seen

used_range_rule: the range of a quantity is the one the rule can give, read from atact.mapping (f in [F0, F0 + F1], s in [S0, S0 + S1]); its share is the middle half, (the third quartile minus the first quartile) divided by that range in percent. The record, the set and the set beside of each row are fixed in the script: the lexicon of work 1 reads sets.sentences of results/paper_work1_same_unit/same_unit.json (record of works/conditions/paper_work1_same_unit.json) and, beside, the mean over the replicates of the share of random_sentences (random_sentences.summary.<quantity>.share_quartiles_percent.mean), computed again from the replicates of the record, every replicate being drawn again by the function draw of works/paper_work1_same_unit.py (the committed script whose SHA-256 the record names) with the seed and the number of replicates of its conditions, the numbers of matched terms of results/work1/work1.json and the lexicon of works/conditions/work1.json, and equal to the recorded one exactly (version 10); map B reads sets.main_G0.pooled and, beside, sets.main_P.pooled of results/paper_used_range/used_range.json (record of works/conditions/paper_used_range.json); the percentiles read sets.main_P.pooled with nothing beside. Each record must be made on its conditions on a clean tree with the installed library; a share of a set must equal 100 (q3 - q1) / width and its n the n named; rounded to a whole number ('N%') it must equal shown.<quantity>, the quantities being exactly f and s. The quartiles of every set shown are computed again from the values word by word or sentence by sentence: the sentences from results/work1/work1.json, the words under map B from results/work2_words/words.json and from results/paper_words_values/words_values.json, and the words under the percentiles from results/paper_words_values/words_values.json, whose rows must be, one to one and in order, the authors and words of words.json with the values of map B of words.json (version 10) (record of works/conditions/paper_words_values.json, made on a clean tree from this used_range.json), after the review of Codex on version 8. The value is built as '{text} ({n} {unit} {f}, {s})', or '{text} ({n} {unit} {f}, {s}; {label} {f2}, {s2})' with the share beside, the phrase fixed in the script; the header of the column and the first line of the note say what the share is. The minimum to maximum and the comparison of words with words (the matched terms of work 1 and its lexicon) are in S1
answers_rule: the judged of a row of work 2 covers one version and one row of the blind judgement: the row remains for a judge if it is in the list of that version (main: the deciding judge of score.json, called the main judge in the paper, whose decided must be true; also: the researcher, of the supplement, whose controls must pass); the outcome is 'both differ' if both lists hold the row, 'neither' if none does and 'split' otherwise; the run stops unless the outcome is the one written. The judged is built as '{text}; for {phrase of the row} {phrase of the outcome}', with the phrases fixed in the script ('both differ': 'both said the rows differ', 'split': 'they split', 'neither': 'neither said the rows differ'; 'words20': 'the 20 words'; a row without a phrase stops the run); the row must be one of the rows of works/conditions/blind_judgement.json, and the version of the answers must be the version fixed in the script for the row id (map B: G0, the percentiles: P). The other rows and versions are in S1
reserved_marks: the dagger and the mark of the compared images are drawn only by the script: a row whose quantity, value, reason, image paths, when or judged contains † or * stops the run
required_checks: a percentage may appear in a value only through used_range, and an outcome of the judgement only through answers: a literal that contains a percentage, or a literal judged of a row of work 2 that names words, stops the run
note: Middle half: Q3 − Q1 as % of the rule's range, counted later.
Judged: whether the two authors' rows differ within one version; versions not compared.
approved_text_rule: every row as written in these conditions (its quantity, value with its kind, check, share and share beside, reason with its parts, images, images compared, time, judged with its check and answers, dagger) is fixed per row id in the script, and so are the headers, the titles, the note, acted_on_labels, compared_mark and the dagger, so that changing any of them needs a change of the script as well as of these conditions; the check of reserved words (SAID) stays as a second check
